title: Full-Grain Leather Bifold Wallet
description_html:
A slim bifold cut from full-grain vegetable-tanned leather that darkens to a rich patina with use.

  • 6 card slots and a full-length bill pocket
  • RFID-blocking lining
  • Hand-stitched edges with waxed thread
  • Free initials embossing

title: Cedar & Amber Beard Care Kit
description_html:
Everything for a soft, tidy beard in one box.

  • 30 ml beard oil with argan and jojoba oils
  • 60 g shaping balm with beeswax and shea butter
  • Pear-wood beard comb
  • Cedar and amber scent, made in small batches

title: Whiskey Stones & Rocks Glass Set
description_html:
Chill a pour without watering it down.

  • Two 10 oz crystal-clear rocks glasses
  • Eight soapstone chilling stones
  • Velvet storage pouch
  • Presented in a wooden gift box

title: Fig & Cedar Soy Candle
description_html:
Hand-poured coconut-soy wax with a cotton wick and notes of ripe fig, cedarwood and a little vanilla.

  • 8 oz, about 50 hours of burn time
  • Reusable amber glass jar
  • Phthalate-free fragrance

title: Stoneware Morning Mug
description_html:
A wheel-thrown stoneware mug with a speckled glaze and a thumb rest on the handle.

  • Holds 12 oz
  • Dishwasher and microwave safe
  • Each glaze turns out slightly different

title: Pour-Over Coffee Starter Set
description_html:
A complete pour-over setup for coffee lovers who like a slow morning ritual.

  • Matte black gooseneck kettle, 1 L, for a steady pour
  • Glass dripper and carafe, brews 2 to 4 cups
  • 100 unbleached paper filters
  • Step-by-step brew card

title: Loose-Leaf Tea Trio
description_html:
Three organic loose-leaf teas in airtight glass jars, about 40 cups in total.

  • Earl Grey with bergamot
  • Blueberry hibiscus, caffeine-free
  • Japanese sencha green tea
  • Stainless steel infuser included

title: 14k Gold-Fill Pendant Necklace
description_html:
A delicate disc pendant on a fine cable chain, made from 14k gold-fill that won't tarnish or fade.

  • 18 in chain with a 2 in extender
  • Hypoallergenic and water-resistant
  • Arrives in a linen jewelry pouch

title: Freshwater Pearl Drop Earrings
description_html:
Two freshwater pearls on each earring, hung from sterling silver posts.

  • Genuine freshwater pearls, 6 to 8 mm
  • Sterling silver posts and backs
  • Hypoallergenic

title: Steel Dive Watch
description_html:
A 40 mm stainless steel dive watch with a two-tone rotating bezel and a Japanese automatic movement.

  • Luminous hands and markers
  • Water-resistant to 200 m
  • Brushed steel bracelet with a fold-over clasp
  • Case back can be engraved

title: Linen-Bound Writing Journal
description_html:
A lay-flat journal bound in natural linen for daily pages, sketches or travel notes.

  • 192 pages of 100 gsm dotted paper
  • Ribbon marker and back pocket
  • A5 size

title: Brass Fountain Pen
description_html:
A solid brass fountain pen that gains a warm patina the more it's used.

  • Fine steel nib with a smooth, even line
  • Takes standard international cartridges
  • Comes with 6 black ink cartridges and a converter

title: Wireless Noise-Cancelling Earbuds
description_html:
True wireless earbuds with active noise cancelling for the commute and the gym.

  • Up to 28 hours with the charging case
  • Sweat- and splash-resistant (IPX5)
  • Bluetooth 5.3 with touch controls
  • Three silicone tip sizes

title: Waterproof Shower Speaker
description_html:
A pocket-size Bluetooth speaker with a suction cup that sticks to tiles and glass, so it goes in the shower.

  • Waterproof (IPX7)
  • 6-hour battery, USB-C charging
  • Built-in mic for hands-free calls
  • Big play/pause button

title: Succulent in Handmade Ceramic Pot
description_html:
A hardy succulent potted in a small handmade ceramic planter with a drainage hole.

  • Needs water only every 2 to 3 weeks
  • Pot is 4 in wide
  • Care card included

title: Spa Night Bath Set
description_html:
A night-in set for a long, slow bath.

  • Four lavender and eucalyptus bath bombs
  • Himalayan pink bath salts, 250 g
  • A small soy candle
  • Made without parabens or sulfates

title: Wooden Counting Abacus
description_html:
A classic beech-wood abacus with 100 brightly painted beads for early counting.

  • Non-toxic water-based paint
  • For ages 3 and up
  • Rounded edges, sturdy base

title: Classic Plush Teddy Bear
description_html:
A soft 12 in teddy bear with embroidered eyes, safe from birth.

  • Plush polyester, machine washable
  • Embroidered features, no small parts
  • Meets EN71 and ASTM toy safety standards

title: Crystal Red Wine Glasses, Set of 2
description_html:
Two lead-free crystal glasses with a wide bowl that opens up a red wine's aroma.

  • 18 oz each
  • Thin laser-cut rims
  • Dishwasher safe
  • Presented in a padded gift box

title: Polarized Acetate Sunglasses
description_html:
Bold black frames cut from Italian acetate, with polarized lenses that cut glare.

  • 100% UV400 protection
  • Five-barrel metal hinges

title: Leather Weekender Duffle
description_html:
A full-grain leather duffle sized for a two-night trip, fits airline overhead bins.

  • Solid brass hardware and a YKK zipper

title: Home Espresso Machine
description_html:
A compact 15-bar espresso machine for cafe-style shots and lattes at home.

  • Steam wand for milk frothing

  • Includes portafilter, two baskets and a tamper

title: Natural Rubber Yoga Mat
description_html:
A grippy 5 mm yoga mat made from natural tree rubber, with a carrying strap.

  • Non-slip even when sweaty

title: Walnut & Maple Chess Set
description_html:
A hand-finished wooden chess set with a walnut and maple board.

  • 15 in folding board that stores the pieces

  • Good for beginners and regular players
